name: Netter Wilson

intro.text: My net, my river. The Enclosure says so, and the salmon don't get a vote.
Cut my net and I'll cut you down to size. Figuratively. I'm not a monster.

win: Ach, the net's tangled round my own feet now. Typical.
after: I hear there's a job going counting the salmon. Counting, not catching. I'll get used to it.
